title: Flashcards: Where it is official, World
intro: Flip each card about the world. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: In which country is Afrikaans an official language?
cards.explain: Afrikaans is an official language of South Africa.

cards.front: In which country is Azerbaijani an official language?
cards.explain: Azerbaijani is an official language of Azerbaijan.

cards.front: In which country is Bislama an official language?
